text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
The incident with the bewitched blade has raised Ruka's popularity
to an all-time high. But dealing with all the people that try
to approach her has left her somewhat exhausted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
妖刀退治の評判が広まり、ルカは一躍街の人気者になったが、
あちこちから声をかけられる状態に疲れを感じはじめていた。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: *sigh*
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁ……

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text:
Hey, it's Ruka!
Do your cool sword stuff for me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あー！　
ルカだー！　
ねぇ、
シュバババッってやってよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Don't be silly. That's not something I do for show.
Maybe next time, okay?
text_block_list.orig_text:
バーカ。
見世物じゃないんだ。
また今度な。

text_block_list.name: Old Man
text_block_list.text: Ruka. Are you sure you can't help with my situation?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なあルカ、
この間の件、
なんとかならんかのう？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You really need to ask someone else.
I can even introduce you if need be.
As for today, though, I'm about to go fishing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうのは他のヤツに頼んどくれよ。
知り合いなら紹介出来るしさ。
今日は今から釣りに行くんだ。

text_block_list.name: Old Woman
text_block_list.text:
Ruka! I finally found you!
Can we talk about setting you up with my son?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああルカ！　
やっと見つけた！　
息子との見合いなんじゃが……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I already told you that's not happening!
Oh, hey! You certainly took your time! Let's get going. Quick!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、だからそれは無理だって……！
おや、お前さん！　
遅かったじゃないか！　
ささ、行こう行こう！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry about that. I kind of had to use you to get away from there.
Sure feels like a long time since I last saw you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……すまないね、
小芝居なんかに付き合わせちまって。
お前さんとも、
ずいぶん久しぶりに会ったような気がするよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You remember our run-in with that bewitched blade?
Turns out stories about that have spread pretty far.
At this point, I'm kind of the talk of the town.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この間の通り魔……
もとい、妖刀退治の話が漏れちまったらしくてね。
ご覧の通り、
一躍街の人気者ってわけさ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I've got all sorts of people approaching me now thanks to that.
Most of them who I don't even know,
including the people back there.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おかげで最近は顔も知らない人たちからも、
声をかけられちまう。
さっき喋ってたのも、
ほとんどが名前も知らないヤツらさ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I'm fine.
Thanks for the concern.
I'd rather not make you worry any more, though.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫だよ。
でもありがとね。
これ以上お前さんを心配させるつもりはないよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, why am I getting all the credit in the end?
You're the one that put your life on the line.
It's only fair that people recognize that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
それよりさ、
どうしてアタシだけチヤホヤされなきゃいけないんだ？
むしろ身体を張ったお前さんこそ、
讃えられるべきだと思うけどね。

text_block_list.name: Challenger
text_block_list.text:
Greetings! I trust you're the very same Lady Ruka who disposed
of that slasher? If so, I would like to request a duel with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
頼も～う！　
通り魔退治のルカ殿とお見受けする！
ぜひ私と一騎打ちを……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: No thanks! Quick, let's get out of here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
嫌だね！　
逃げるよお前さん！

text_block_list.name: Challenger
text_block_list.text: W-wait! You can't flee after it took me so long to find you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
待ってくれーっ！　
ようやく見つけたんだぞーっ！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Argh, come on! I'm sick of this already!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ったくもう！　
こんなのばっかりで嫌になる！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Okay, back on topic.
This newfound fame's led a bunch of people to try
and boost their own reputation by challenging and defeating me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……さっきの続きでさ。
有名になったアタシを倒して、
名をあげようとするヤツが最近増えてるんだ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: But honestly? I just want to live a nice, relaxed life.
text_block_list.orig_text:
だいたいアタシはね、
のんびり生きていきたいんだよ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Helping people in need is all well and good.
But why should I indulge others in pointless conflict?
text_block_list.orig_text:
困ってる人からの相談ならまだいいさ。
でも無駄なケンカや争いを起こして何になるってんだ？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
If they want to prove their strength,
they should just go fight some monsters.
Right?
choice_data_list: I get where you're coming from.
Try not to think about it too much.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなに強さを見せつけたけりゃ、
魔物と戦えばいいじゃないか。
そうだろう？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Hearing that from you's a big relief.
I honestly just don't want to fight unless it's
for someone else's sake.
text_block_list.orig_text:
良かった……
お前さんに分かってもらえて嬉しいよ。
誰かの役に立つこと以外で人と戦うのは、
勘弁して欲しいね……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. I'm trying not to, but it's kind of hard...
Ideally I'd just not have to worry about it in the first place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとね。
分かっちゃいるんだけど、
つい考えちまうんだ……
アタシもこんな悩みとは、
早くおさらばしたいもんさ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You know what's even more frustrating about all this?
I can't even sit back and fish in peace anymore.
No opportunities to nap, either. Sheesh.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんな有様のおかげで、
こうして道具を持って出ても、
のんびり釣りにも行けやしない……
おまけに昼寝もだ。
やれやれ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
It's nice being able to get that off my chest, though.
Funny how you're always here to help at the end of the day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも話を聞いてもらったら、
少しすっきりしたよ。
なんだかんだお前さんには助けられちまうね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
My guildmates have all been pretty busy recently, too,
so this is the first time I've had a real chance to talk about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
最近はギルドのみんなも忙しくてさ、
愚痴を聞いてくれるヤツがいなかったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Say, how does going for some lunch sound?
There's still plenty I want to talk about.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうだ、
せっかくだしお前さんさえよければ、
飯でもどうだい？
もうちょっと話を聞いておくれよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Ahhh... It's nice being able to finally relax.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はぁ～……
ようやくのんびり出来るよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I was kind of hoping we'd have the opportunity to
unwind together like this sometime, too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
たまにはこうしてお前さんとも、
ゆっくり過ごしたかったんだ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Oh yeah. I still haven't tried the fish set here,
now that I think about it.
Want to try it with me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう言えば、
ここの魚定食って、
まだ試してなかったな。
お前さんも同じものでいいかい？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Excuse me! We're ready to or—
text_block_list.orig_text:
すみませーん、
注文を……

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: You're Ruka, aren't you?
text_block_list.orig_text: お前がルカね？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: I am. And who are you, exactly?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そうだけど、
アンタは？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Prepare yourself!
I'm here to take revenge on you for my brother!
text_block_list.orig_text:
問答無用！　
兄の復讐のため、
お前を倒す！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Well that doesn't sound pleasant.
Scuttle on home before you get hurt, will you?
text_block_list.orig_text:
復讐とはまた穏やかじゃないね。
怪我しないうちに、
おとなしく帰った方が身のためだよ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Shut up! It's your fault that he got caught!
Now he's rotting away in a cell for producing illegal magical equipment!
text_block_list.orig_text:
黙りなさい！　
私の兄はお前たちに捕まったのよ！
兄は魔法具を密造した罪で、
今も牢獄に囚われたまま……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Oh. That definitely rings a bell.
Sorry, but your brother was a villain through and through.
He had it coming.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……そういえばあったね、
そんなこと。
でもアンタの兄貴は悪党だった。
自業自得だろう？

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
What he did was wrong, sure.
But he was always kind to me and our parents!
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに兄は悪事を働いた……
でも私や両親には優しい人だったわ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't change anything.
To you, he was a kind brother.
To me, he was just a villain. Plain and simple.
text_block_list.orig_text:
逆も同じさ。
アンタにとって兄貴がいいヤツでもね、
アタシから見ればただの悪人だったよ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Fine. Then the same applies to you. There's plenty of
people who hold a grudge against you. That makes you
a villain to us. And we have every right to take you down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう……
なら私たちは、
私たちにとっての悪人、
お前を倒すわ！
お前に怨みを持つ人間は、
たくさんいるのよ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Are there now? Then how about you round them up for me?
I wouldn't mind taking out all this frustration on them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どこにいるってんだい？　
いるなら連れてきな。
相手になってやろうじゃないか。
こっちも鬱憤溜まってんだ。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Be careful what you wish for!
text_block_list.orig_text: じゃあお望み通り連れてきてあげる！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: So that's her, huh?!
text_block_list.orig_text: コイツがルカか！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: You're gonna pay for what you did to my bud!
text_block_list.orig_text: よくもオレのダチをやってくれたなぁ！

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text: Hope you're ready for a one-way trip to hell!
text_block_list.orig_text: 覚悟出来てんのかテメー！？

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Well, would you look at that. She really did round them up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
驚いた……
ホントにいやがったとはね。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
It's not just people with a grudge against you, either.
You've avoided plenty of duels, so I brought them as well.
There's dozens of us here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前に倒された人たちの縁者や家族だけじゃない。
一騎打ちの申し出を逃げられた者も加えて、
ざっと数十人はいるわ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. There really is no upside to being strong, is there?
The more I fight, the harder it is to escape the fallout from it.
choice_data_list: Offer to fight by her side.
text_block_list.orig_text:
やれやれ……
やっぱり強くてもいいことなんて一つもありゃしない。
誰かと戦えば戦うほど、
こうしてどっかで因果は巡ってきちまう……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, but I'd rather you sit this one out.
This isn't a matter you should get yourself involved in.
text_block_list.orig_text:
申し出は嬉しいけど、
今回は遠慮させておくれ。
このケンカにお前さんは関わっちゃいけないよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You reap what you sow. And I've sown a lot.
There is one thing you can do, though.
Mind taking care of my fishing equipment for me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシが今までのツケを払うだけさ。
お前さんの助けはいらないよ。
でもそうだね……
釣り道具を預かっといておくれ。
頼んだよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Anyone that's got an issue with me, step up or shut up!
Let's settle this outside!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシに用があるヤツら！　
全員、
表に出な！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
We won't bother anyone else here.
Dealing with you one by one is too much of a pain,
so just come at me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここなら誰にも迷惑はかからないね。
……一人ずつなんて面倒だ。
まとめてかかってきな！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Let's party, troops!
text_block_list.orig_text: いくぞテメェら！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text:
You ain't the boss here!
Go get her!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オメーが仕切んじゃねぇ！　
やっちまえー！

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text: I'mma slice you up nice and good!
text_block_list.orig_text: 切り刻んでやんよぉ！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
Be careful if you're using magic!
Make sure she's the only one you hit!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法で誤射しないよう気をつけて！　
標的はあの女一人よ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
This will go south real quick if I don't focus.
Get ready! I'm going all out! Hah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
コイツはいつもより気合い入れないとマズそうだね……
出し惜しみは無しでいくよ！　
はあっ！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Nngh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐあっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hah!
text_block_list.orig_text: せいっ！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Gragh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぎゃあっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hup!
text_block_list.orig_text: ふっ！

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text: Argh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐおぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Dammit! They weren't lying about how strong she is!
text_block_list.orig_text:
くそっ！　
噂通りの強さだな……！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
That kid over there... he was with Ruka, wasn't he?
Think you can just sit back and watch, eh?! Raaagh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういやあのガキ、
ルカと一緒にいた……
高みの見物か！
うおりゃっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
What the?! Quit it!
He's got nothing to do with this! Don't get him involved!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん！？　
やめろっ！
アンタたちの敵はアタシだろ！　
その子には手を出すんじゃないよ！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Shut it! I'll take any shortcut I need to put you down for good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うるせぇ！　
お前を倒せるなら、
なんだってやってやらぁ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You think I'll let you?!
text_block_list.orig_text: させるかっ！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Gurgh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぐへっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You okay?!
The wound doesn't seem that deep... Thank goodness.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん！　
無事か！？
傷は大したことないね。
良かった……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Hey. I hope you're ready for what's about to happen to you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……アンタたち、
覚悟は出来てるんだろうね？

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text: Eeek!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひっ！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: You're the one that brought him here! It's all on you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
テメェこそ、
こんな所に部外者連れてくんじゃねぇ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Sorry. Really, I am.
I never meant to get you involved in my business.
choice_data_list: No worries. I've got your back.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんよ……
結局巻き込んじまった。
こんなはずじゃなかったんだけどね……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Thanks. Just hearing that is enough to make me happy.
Don't worry, though. I've got my own back.
For now, at least.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ありがとう。
その心意気だけで、
十分嬉しいよ。
でも大丈夫。
自分の背中は自分で守るよ……
今はまだね。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Do me a favor and open up the bag with my fishing equipment,
will you? There it is. Time for you to shine.
text_block_list.orig_text:
お前さん。
釣り道具の袋、
開けておくれ。
……あった。
コイツもここらでお披露目だ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Haromaru!
Let's give these rogues a little taste of what you're capable of!
text_block_list.orig_text:
──行くよ波浪丸！　
アンタの切れ味、
お見舞いしてやりな！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Wh-what the?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
な、
なんなんだぁ！？

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Did she seriously just pull out another katana?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こいつ、
刀をもう一本抜きやがった！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Never expected to use this so soon.
text_block_list.orig_text: こんなに早く、コイツを使うことになるとはね……

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text: She's dual wielding?! That can't be right!
text_block_list.orig_text:
二刀流！？　
聞いてないぞそんなの！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Why were you under the impression that I can't dual wield?
You put your hands on someone dear to me.
And the price for that is steep. You'd best be prepared!
text_block_list.orig_text:
誰も一刀流だなんて言った覚えはないよ。
……アタシの大事な人に手を出したんだ。
覚悟は出来てるだろうね！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Right back at you! Hah!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それはこっちのセリフよ！　
はあっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Pathetic!
You really hope to defeat me like that?
text_block_list.orig_text:
甘いっ！
……こんなもん、
覚悟とは呼べないね。

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: N-no way...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そんな……！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
If you want a piece of me, then come get it.
Just don't expect your little revenge story to work out!
Twentieth Strike: Heaven and Earth!
text_block_list.orig_text:
かかってくるなら、
お望み通り全員叩き斬って、
返り討ちにしてやるよ！
二十の太刀、
水天一碧！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Eeeeeek!
text_block_list.orig_text: ひいいいいっ！

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text: Sh-she's a monster!
text_block_list.orig_text: つ、強すぎる……！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
We picked the wrong person to mess with!
Waaahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
オレら、とんでもないヤツを相手にしちまってたんだ……！
うわあああっ！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Phew... Do you want to keep this little dance going?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ……
まだ続けるかい？

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Not at all!
Your strength is more than apparent at this point!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いいえ……！　
もう十分です！
十分あなたの強さは分かりました！

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text:
Boss Lady! I am so, thoroughly moved!
Please make me your disciple!
text_block_list.orig_text:
姉御！　
オレ、
感動しました！
　弟子にしてください！

text_block_list.name: Man 2
text_block_list.text: Us too!
text_block_list.orig_text: 俺たちもお願いします！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text:
I was curious why my brother seemed to have straightened
up when I visited him in prison, but now I know. Please
forgive me, Ruka! No, Lady Ruka! I was wrong all along!
text_block_list.orig_text:
捕まった兄が、
面会の時真面目になっていた理由が分かりました……
私が間違ってました！　
ごめんなさいルカさん！　
いえ、
お姉さま！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Th-this again?
Sheesh. I swear...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
またこうなっちまった……
やれやれ、
どいつもこいつも……

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text: Boss Lady! We're begging you!
text_block_list.orig_text: お願いします姉御！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text: Give us a chance!
text_block_list.orig_text: ルカの姉御！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Lady Ruka!
text_block_list.orig_text: お姉さま！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Argh! Give me a break!
First and foremost, get this mess cleaned up,
and throw yourselves in a cell!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁ～
もう鬱陶しい！
とりあえず全員で後片付けして牢屋に入ってきな！

text_block_list.name: Man 3
text_block_list.text: Wow! She's giving us an opportunity to start over!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおおっ！
　これは人生をやり直すチャンスをくださったのだ！

text_block_list.name: Man 1
text_block_list.text:
Nah. This is definitely her method of
getting us ready to become her disciples!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
弟子入りのための修行に違いない！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: There's no better way to see my brother again than being confined myself!
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も兄に会いに行きます……
獄中で！

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, yeah. Get going already.
...*sigh*
They're finally gone. I am [i]so[/i] exhausted.
text_block_list.orig_text:
はいはい、
行ってらっしゃい。
……
はぁ。
全員いなくなったね。
あ～疲れた……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: You sit yourself down, too. There we go.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら、
お前さんも腰かけなよ。
よっと

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
You said you've got my back, right? Then bear with me for a bit...
Sorry for getting you involved.
But it was a relief knowing you were there with me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほんの少しだけでいいんだ……
背中、
預けさせておくれ……
……巻き込んで悪かったね。
でも、
そばにいてくれて助かったよ。

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text:
I really, really don't want to move another inch today.
So much for fishing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日はもう、
さすがに動きたくないね……
釣りの予定が台無しだよ……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Anyway, yeah... Thank... you...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……お前さん、
あり……
がと……

text_block_list.name: Ruka
text_block_list.text: Zzz... Zzz...
text_block_list.orig_text: すぅ……

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't long before rumors of Ruka's battle spread
all through Landosol. Largely due to a certain ninja,
who just so happened to witness it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
この日のルカの戦いは、瞬く間にランドソル中の噂となったが、
その原因は偶然戦いを見ていた一人のシノビによるものだった。
